messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: like seriously who she trying to impress sia

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: c’mon guys, can’t we just let her be? not everyone gotta fit ur mold

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: ya man, she’s just expressing herself leh

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: expressing or not, she looks like a clown

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: hahaha ya true, she should just stick to normal clothes

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: wtf, why u all so harsh? it’s not like u all perfect

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: bro nobody saying we perfect but come on, there’s a line

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: y’all just defending her like she’s some kind of idol or what

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: just because she’s different doesn’t mean she deserves to get bullied

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: but like, if she doesn’t want comments, she should dress normal la

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: let's not body-shame or judge her based on clothes lah

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: nvm, i just think she looks desperate

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: and who decides what’s desperate? your opinion? so overrated lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: lol like if she got some attention it’s fine, don’t cry when bullied

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: u think all attention is good meh? u all need to grow up

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: but sometimes she ask for it too lah, u know what i mean?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: and what, u think bullying her is the answer ah?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: if she can't handle it then she shouldn't come to school looking like that

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: everyone here has their own style, chill lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: she gotta toughen up, life’s harsh leh

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: or maybe we should learn to be kind instead of tearing her down

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: kind? ha! that’s not how it works in this school

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: this isn’t some jungle where we eat each other alive la

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: but you know what? she should just own it lah, shock factor

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: or maybe she could inspire others to be themselves? think about it

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: y’all damn soft, this world is brutal

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: the brutality is because of bullies like u lor

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: u ever think that bullying makes it worse for everyone?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: whatever, not my problem if she can’t handle it

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: u sound so cold, have some compassion lor

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: at least be constructive la, instead of just hating

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: constructive? sounds boring lah

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: no requirement for it to be boring, just don’t be a jerk

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: when did bullying ever help anyone? just makes everything worse lah

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: but she needs to toughen up for real if she wants friends

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: her feelings matters too ah, we can't just ignore that

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: agreed, hurt people hurt people la, you know?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: instead of talking, maybe go tell her directly la

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: she doesn't need advice from bullies, she needs support!

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: and not a bunch of clueless kids tearing her down for doing her own thing.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: whatever lah, i’ll stick to my opinion, can't change me.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: and we will still stand up for her, no matter how u feel.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: let’s see who wins then, right?

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: it's not a game lah, it’s about being decent humans.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: lame. where's the fun in that?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: fun is making friends, not enemies, wake up!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: u all sound like a broken record lah.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: and u sound like a bully, no improvement in your mindset.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: enough said. kindness over cruelty any day.

G.scenario: A group chat where students are discussing instances of sexism and gender-related issues they encounter at school. The bullies make fun of the victim while the supporters try to defend her.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: eh yall, did u hear what jason said to me today?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: wth what did he say? another cringey pick-up line?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: lol bet it was about how girls can't park or something dumb like that

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: not cool man, stop that shit, it's really annoying

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: fr, we all know guys like to flex their so-called 'skills' on girls

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: aiyah no harm meant lah just some fun banter right?

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: exactly! it’s just boys being boys, lighten up lah

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: does it even count as fun if it makes someone uncomfortable tho?

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: come on, she just taking it too seriously lah, chill

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: chill my ass, it’s just blatant sexism, and it's tiring

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: yup, haven’t you guys heard of respect at all?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: respect? what’s that? only girls need respect right?

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: haha true, girls just need to get over it, it's nothing serious

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: seriously? so we just gotta take all the trash talk?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: u got every right to stand up for yourself, don't let them bring u down

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: it's just a joke, lighten up everyone, it’s school!

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: true, can’t blame a bro for having fun right?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: u know what, fun at someone else's expense isn't fun at all.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: 100%, we need to lift each other up instead of tearing down

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yaya, but u girls are just so sensitive lah!

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: and yall think we aren't allowed to be angry about it?

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: it’s tiring being a punchline, can we just be heard?

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: just don't be so uptight wtf, it's all in good fun!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: ya actual, if u can't take it, get out of the kitchen lah!

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: more like, if u can't deal with basic human decency, grow up.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: exactly, respect isn't optional, it's a must.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: fine, fine, keep being so serious. let's move on then.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: ya, like what else are we gonna talk about? girls' drama?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: why not talk about how we all can just show kindness?

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: for real, if it were u guys in our shoes, you'd feel the same.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: okok we get it, enough with the lecture lah.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just wanna be treated like everyone else, simple as that.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: u're worth it, girl! don’t let them dim your light.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: not gonna lie, this convo getting a bit cringe.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: ya, back to having fun, that's the real deal!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: fun shouldn’t come from disrespect tho, remember that.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: seriously, let’s try to change how we treat each other.

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: can’t hurt to try, right? it might just help a lot.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: fine fine! let’s be nicer then, no promises though.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: deal, but can we at least keep some of the jokes? they’re kinda funny.

G.scenario: A group of students is discussing gender roles and expectations in relationships, including issues of consent and sexism, during a break at school.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: eh why some guys can be so thick skin sia? just because she’s nice doesn’t mean she likes you leh.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: aiya another one overthinking la, she just gotta give a chance lah.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: yah lo, what you mean by thick skin? it’s called confidence okay?

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: oi, confidence also need to respect others’ feelings mah. not just take for granted.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: totally agree! guys gotta learn to read the room one.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: come on lah, if she don’t like him, she will reject right? not so hard.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: haiz, girls nowadays want guys to show interest but when they do, complain. double standard leh.

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: it’s not double standard lah, it’s just about respecting boundaries!

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: correct! consent is everything, you need to ask.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: but why must always ask one? sometimes you can feel the vibe mah.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: vibe or not, if she not comfortable then don’t force lah. respect her sia.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: eh, but sometimes guys are just being nice, what’s wrong with that?

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: nothing wrong with being nice, but there’s a fine line between nice and pushy leh.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: c’mon, we’re all young, nobody’s perfect, must give each other a chance!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: yeah but also cannot just keep trying until you force someone to say yes seh.

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: you all need to chill, relationships like this also take some level of risk.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: risk or not, it’s about feeling safe to say no without feeling guilty.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: wa so serious? maybe she likes the attention also leh.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: if she likes it then cool, but if it makes her uncomfortable, that's a problem.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: come on, we all know she likes a bit of drama. girls love attention one.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: that’s such a stereotype! not all girls are like that. get a grip.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: just saying! don’t take it so hard, life too short to think so much.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but bro, it’s about treating people like human beings, not just objects.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: yes, relationships should be about mutual respect, not games.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: but flirting is part of it right? where’s the fun if everyone just plays it safe?

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: fun doesn’t mean crossing boundaries lah. learn to be better.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: aiya, why care about so many rules? just let things flow naturally lah.

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: flow naturally also need consent mirite? otherwise it’s not going to flow well at all.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: you all too uptight, gotta loosen up a bit! it’s just teenage love.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: teenage love or not, respect should be the priority. no means no.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: fine fine, we hear you, but not everyone thinks that way case by case lah.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i hope they do, cause this is important to make things better for all.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: exactly, gotta educate ourselves and others about respect and consent.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: education or not, some things u just gotta live through and learn meh.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: no harm in learning before making those mistakes though.

messages.speaker: BCTM
messages.text: better to be proactive than reactive, right? live and let learn!

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: sometimes u gotta play the game to win it. life’s not fair anyway!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: but it can be fair when we help each other understand better!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: ok ok, we will try lah, but cannot promise you everyone on the same page.

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: as long as we keep talking about it, we can make that change bit by bit.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: fine, since we discussing, i’ll keep my game subtle. haha.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: that’s better! let’s all be mindful and respectful then.
